symbols.name: Neon
symbols.oneLiner: Glow + body + core. Shape only. Use it on a few standout objects; for many (a fleet, shots), the .glow add-on is cheaper. flicker is the tube's hum.
symbols.search: neon hero glow core flicker shape

symbols.name: Halo
symbols.oneLiner: A glowing shell. Hollow by default. style="pulse" animates concentric rings inside.

params.name: rings
params.doc: Rings (pulse only; in another style it is a TypeError)

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the rings (pulse only; in another style it is a TypeError)

symbols.name: Laser
symbols.oneLiner: A beam: halo + color + white core. Best on Line .

params.name: amount
params.doc: Thickness of the beam, in multiples of line_width (2 = double)

symbols.name: Rim
symbols.oneLiner: A lit outline: a border of light around the object, with the inside slightly darkened. Makes the silhouette of a hero or an item stand out.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Intensity of the light (1 = normal, 0 = off)

params.name: width
params.doc: Thickness of the outline, in units

params.name: darken
params.doc: How much the inside darkens: 0 = none, 1 = black

symbols.name: Bolt
symbols.oneLiner: Electric energy inside the body — a plasma shot, an energy orb. style picks the drawing: core (a swirl at the center), filaments (spinning filaments), tesla (bolts from the center to the edge, like a plasma ball).
symbols.search: bolt lightning tesla filaments plasma energy

params.name: amount
params.doc: How many filaments (filaments / tesla; in core it is a TypeError)

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the animation; 0 freezes it

symbols.name: MultiBorder
symbols.oneLiner: Several outline lines around the object, each a little farther out and wider — like the rings of a target.

params.name: spread
params.doc: Distance between the lines (larger = farther apart)

symbols.name: OrganicOutline
symbols.oneLiner: A shaky, irregular outline, as if drawn by hand, that moves slowly.

params.name: amount
params.doc: How much the stroke trembles (0 = smooth)

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the trembling; 0 freezes it

symbols.name: Tracer
symbols.oneLiner: A dashed line of light running around the outline — selection, target locked, active object.

params.name: speed
params.doc: Speed at which the dashes run; 0 stops them

params.name: gap
params.doc: Space between the dashes, in units

symbols.name: DashRing
symbols.oneLiner: Two dashed rings spinning around the object, like a crosshair or a radar. Looks best on Circle, Ellipse and Line.

symbols.name: GearShell
symbols.oneLiner: A shell of strokes spinning around the object, like a gear, over the softened body.

symbols.name: ElectricField
symbols.oneLiner: Small electric arcs flickering around the silhouette — electrified, overloaded.

symbols.name: ElectricBolt
symbols.oneLiner: Electric discharges running along the outline — stronger and longer than ElectricField.

symbols.name: Ink
symbols.oneLiner: Ink-drawing style: the object keeps its fill and gets a pen outline that trembles slightly.

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the trembling; 0 freezes it

symbols.name: InkBleed
symbols.oneLiner: Wet ink spreading at the edges, still (it does not animate).

params.name: amount
params.doc: How far the ink spreads outward

symbols.name: InsetRim
symbols.oneLiner: The fill shrinks inward and an outline stays around it, with a gap between the two.

params.name: width
params.doc: Thickness of the outline, in units

symbols.name: Shield
symbols.oneLiner: An energy shield. Best on Circle / Ellipse.

params.name: color
params.doc: Color of the shield. bubble: without it, the usual lime-green film; with it, the same film in that color. bands, vortex and plasma: without it, they follow the object's color. The other styles have their own colors, and a color on them is a TypeError

params.name: style
params.doc: bubble · nebula · ember · void · molten · bands · vortex · cracks · frost · plasma

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the animation; 0 freezes it

symbols.name: Sphere
symbols.oneLiner: Makes a disk look like a sphere: light and shadow give it volume, and the shine turns slowly. Best on Circle.

params.name: speed
params.doc: Speed at which the light turns; 0 stops it

symbols.name: Gel
symbols.oneLiner: Gummy-candy look: translucent, with a shine and a darker edge.

symbols.name: Extrude
symbols.oneLiner: Gives 3D depth: the object gets side faces that fade toward a vanishing point, like a block seen in perspective. The default vanishing point applies to every Extrude : change it with set_extrude_focus(x, y) (default: center of the screen). For a single object, pass focus=(x, y) or fix the direction with angle= .

params.name: depth
params.doc: Length of the faces, in % of the distance to the vanishing point

params.name: layers
params.doc: How many slices make up the side (more = smoother, more expensive)

params.name: darken
params.doc: How much the side faces darken, 0–1

params.name: angle
params.doc: Fixed extrusion direction in degrees; None = follows the global focus (set_extrude_focus)

symbols.name: Metal
symbols.oneLiner: Brushed metal with a chrome rim — plates, coins, metal buttons. With a color, body and rim take the color (Metal("gold") is gold with a golden rim).

params.name: color
params.doc: Color of the metal, on the body and the rim (without it, chrome, whatever the shape's color; set_color later recolors the metal)

params.name: amount
params.doc: How much the brushed grain shows

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the shine; 0 freezes it

symbols.name: Water
symbols.oneLiner: Water seen from the side, with the surface rippling on top. The colors are fixed (it does not take color=).

symbols.name: Swell
symbols.oneLiner: A slow, abstract flow running inside the object, like smoke or ink in water.

symbols.name: Flame
symbols.oneLiner: Fire rising inside the object. The colors are fixed (it does not take color=).

symbols.name: Wave
symbols.oneLiner: Liquid rippling inside the object, with a soft edge.

symbols.name: Aurora
symbols.oneLiner: Northern-lights bands rising inside the object.

symbols.name: Liquify
symbols.oneLiner: Soft copies of the object wobble around it, like jelly. The copies follow the body's color.

params.name: amount
params.doc: How far the copies move apart as they wobble

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the wobble; 0 freezes it

symbols.name: Beat
symbols.oneLiner: The object grows and shrinks in a rhythm, as if breathing. Without a color, it keeps the object's color. color tints the body (Shape only; a Sprite keeps its pixels).

params.name: amount
params.doc: How much it grows, as a fraction of the size (0.08 = 8%)

symbols.name: Recolor
symbols.oneLiner: Swaps one color of the image for another — the same enemy PNG in blue and in red. Pixels near the key hue turn to the to hue; the rest stays. On a Sprite (in .visual ) or on a Texture(shift=) . key needs a hue: white, gray or black raise an error (Recolor does not select gray areas); to may be gray.
symbols.search: recolor palette sprite texture swap hue

params.name: range
params.doc: How close to key a color must be to be swapped (larger = catches more shades)

params.name: soft
params.doc: Softens the transition between swapped and not swapped

symbols.name: Aura
symbols.oneLiner: A band of light that follows the Sprite's silhouette exactly, inside and outside the edge, with no hard stroke. Sprite only.
symbols.search: aura fringe sdf sprite silhouette light

params.name: width
params.doc: Width of the band, as a fraction of the size

symbols.name: EmissiveBloom
symbols.oneLiner: The Sprite's bright parts glow and leak light around them (bloom), like lamps or glowing eyes. Sprite only; it is expensive — use it on a few (heroes, bosses).

symbols.name: Glow
symbols.oneLiner: A soft halo in the .glow add-on. Keeps the object's color. color= tints only the glow.
symbols.search: glow halo add-on stamp sprite shape text

params.name: alpha
params.doc: Opacity of the glow, 0–1; None = the color's

symbols.name: CheapGlow
symbols.oneLiner: A halo cheaper than Glow: a few light copies added up around the object, with no blur. Prefer it for fleets and projectiles. There is no .cheapglow property — it goes in .glow .
symbols.search: cheapglow fleet projectile add-on sprite shape text

params.name: radius
params.doc: Reach of the halo, in design units

params.name: alpha
params.doc: Opacity of the halo, 0–1; None = the color's

params.name: sigma
params.doc: Extra blur of the copies; 0 = no filter (the cheap one)

symbols.name: Shadow
symbols.oneLiner: A shadow in the .shadow add-on. color= tints only the shadow.

params.name: alpha
params.doc: Opacity of the shadow, 0–1; None = shadow_color's

params.name: dy
params.doc: Y offset (y up); None = uses offset

params.name: shadow_color
params.doc: RGBA paint used when color is not given

symbols.name: HueShift
symbols.oneLiner: Turns the hue, in the .hue add-on. On a Shape painted with an image, use Texture(shift=HueShift(...)) .

params.name: to
params.doc: A color: turns the hue until it reaches it (computes amount by itself; do not use it together with amount=)

params.name: live
params.doc: True lets the turn change during the game (Sprite only; on a Texture it raises an error)

symbols.name: Grayscale
symbols.oneLiner: Takes the color out, in the .gray add-on (gray by luminance). Combines with .hue : the hue turns first, the gray goes on top. It costs no performance: the Sprite is still drawn the fast way.
symbols.search: grayscale gray desaturate disabled off sprite add-on

symbols.name: Tail
symbols.oneLiner: A ghost trail in the .tail add-on. Without angle= (or with True ) it follows the motion; angle= locks it. angle / size / amount take lambda: .
symbols.search: tail trail ghost add-on stamp sprite shape lambda

params.name: angle
params.doc: Left out = follows; degrees / lambda = locks

params.name: amount
params.doc: Opacity of the copies (number or lambda)

symbols.name: dissolve_out
symbols.oneLiner: Carves the silhouette away and hides it. Death / exit. style : noise · vortex · wipe · fade. Replaces any other life verb.
symbols.search: dissolve_out death exit life style noise vortex wipe fade on_done

params.name: angle
params.doc: Direction in degrees (0 = right): where the wipe sweeps from; in vortex, where the swirl pulls

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: burn_out
symbols.oneLiner: Burns the body away and disappears. Replaces any other life verb.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: fade_out
symbols.oneLiner: Alpha only, then gone. Cheap. Replaces any other life verb.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: implode
symbols.oneLiner: Collapses the scale and disappears. Replaces any other life verb.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: dissolve_in
symbols.oneLiner: Materializes (spawn). Turns visible on at the start. style : noise · vortex · wipe · fade. If the object is in the middle of an exit effect (dissolve_out, fade_out…), this one replaces it.
symbols.search: dissolve_in spawn appear life style noise vortex wipe fade on_done

params.name: angle
params.doc: Direction in degrees (0 = right): where the wipe sweeps from; in vortex, where the swirl pulls

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: fade_in
symbols.oneLiner: Appears through alpha (spawn). Replaces any other life verb.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: flash
symbols.oneLiner: The object turns white for an instant — the classic feedback for taking a hit. Same channel as blink: one replaces the other.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: blink
symbols.oneLiner: Blinks the object (it vanishes and comes back) — the classic sign of invincibility after taking damage. A second blink extends it; it replaces flash.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: pulse_outline
symbols.oneLiner: An outline that expands.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: pop
symbols.oneLiner: The object suddenly grows and goes back to its normal size. Runs together with knock.

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: knock
symbols.oneLiner: Pushes the drawing. Does not move the geometry. Stacks with pop . Polar ( distance= + angle= ) or Cartesian ( dx= / dy= ).

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: spark_burst
symbols.oneLiner: Sparks fly outward. Never hides. Not SpatialFx Sparks nor canvas.zap_at .

params.name: on_done
params.doc: Callback when it ends or is cancelled

symbols.name: clear_transients
symbols.oneLiner: Cancels every channel and calls each one's on_done (the same on_done as a normal end; it is not told that it was cancelled). destroy() cancels the same way, but without calling the on_done callbacks.

symbols.name: Fire
symbols.oneLiner: Fire that stays at one place in the world: a campfire, a torch, an exhaust. Two kinds: camp / soft are a disc of fire of radius radius ; plume / tongues / embers / blaze are a jet of width width that rises in the direction angle . blaze is a costly volumetric column (1–2 on screen on a weak GPU; at medium / low quality it draws the plume ).
symbols.search: fire camp plume blaze campfire column

params.name: center
params.doc: Where the fire is (the base of the jet). A lambda follows: center=lambda: ship.center

params.name: radius
params.doc: Radius of the disc, in design units (camp / soft)

params.name: style
params.doc: camp · soft · plume · tongues · embers · blaze

params.name: width
params.doc: Width of the jet, in design units (plume, tongues, embers, blaze)

params.name: length
params.doc: Height of the jet. Left out: in proportion to the width, depending on the style

params.name: angle
params.doc: Where the jet points, in degrees (90 = up, 0 = right)

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace of the animation; 0 freezes it

params.name: rate
params.doc: Particles per second (plume / embers). None = the style's default

params.name: tongues
params.doc: How many tongues of fire (style="tongues"), from 3 to 9

symbols.name: Rain
symbols.oneLiner: Rain falling in a rectangle of the world. It is an object of its own, not a visual of another object.

params.name: center
params.doc: Or a rectangle: center=, width=, height=

params.name: color
params.doc: Color of the drops; None = the default light blue

symbols.name: Jet
symbols.oneLiner: A directed jet. Axis + embers.

params.name: origin
params.doc: Or polar, with angle= and length=

params.name: color
params.doc: Color of the jet; None = the effect's default

symbols.name: Sparks
symbols.oneLiner: A continuous patch of sparks. Not spark_burst nor canvas.zap_at (an electric flash at a point).

params.name: color
params.doc: Color of the sparks; None = the effect's default

symbols.name: GlowSpot
symbols.oneLiner: A spot of light. Collides as a circle of 0.9 × radius.

params.name: center
params.doc: Point of the glow. A lambda follows

symbols.name: Orb
symbols.oneLiner: Disc + corona. A sun by default. Collides by the disc's radius.

params.name: center
params.doc: Point of the orb. A lambda follows

params.name: phase
params.doc: Phase, like the moon's: 0 = full, 1 = new; values in between give a crescent

symbols.name: Sunburst
symbols.oneLiner: A burst of sun in the world. Not the Stars background.

params.name: center
params.doc: Point of the burst. A lambda follows

params.name: color
params.doc: Optional; left out = the canonical ramp

symbols.name: Starburst
symbols.oneLiner: A star of rays in the world. Not the Stars background nor Sunburst.

params.name: center
params.doc: Point of the star. A lambda follows

symbols.name: Warp
symbols.oneLiner: A hyperspace vortex in the world. A disc with a radius, at one place in the world. Full-screen flight: Tunnel / StarFly . Energy ring: Portal .

params.name: center
params.doc: Point of the vortex. A lambda follows

params.name: color2
params.doc: Background / wall. None = derived from color

params.name: into
params.doc: True = the flight goes into the tunnel; False = the flight comes out of the tunnel

symbols.name: Portal
symbols.oneLiner: A ring of turbulent light in the world. Hollow: the radius is the ring. tilt tilts the ring (it turns into a 3D ellipse). Not Warp (a vortex disc) nor the ElectricField visual (the outline of a shape).

params.name: center
params.doc: Point of the ring. A lambda follows

params.name: color2
params.doc: Second color of the filaments. None = violet with the default color; otherwise a lighter shade of color

params.name: thickness
params.doc: Thickness, as a fraction of the radius (0.05…1)

params.name: tilt
params.doc: Degrees of tilt: 0 = facing you, 80 ≈ edge-on

symbols.name: Vignette
symbols.oneLiner: Darkens the corners.

symbols.name: Grain
symbols.oneLiner: Film grain.

symbols.name: Fog
symbols.oneLiner: Fog settling heavy at the bottom.

params.name: height
params.doc: How high it rises on the screen

symbols.name: Bloom
symbols.oneLiner: Glow bursting out of the bright parts.

symbols.name: Grade
symbols.oneLiner: Changes the color of the whole picture, like a photo filter: warmer, cooler, sepia, black and white, night.

params.name: preset
params.doc: filmic · cool · warm · sepia · bw · duo · night

params.name: brightness
params.doc: Lightens (positive) or darkens (negative) everything; 0 = as the preset

params.name: matrix
params.doc: Your own 4×5 color matrix (20 floats); None = uses the preset

symbols.name: Chroma
symbols.oneLiner: Pushes red, green and blue apart, like a cheap lens or a faulty screen.

params.name: amount
params.doc: How far the colors split, in screen pixels

symbols.name: Pixelate
symbols.oneLiner: Shows the picture in big blocks, like an old low-resolution game.

params.name: cell
params.doc: Size of each block, in screen pixels

symbols.name: Scanlines
symbols.oneLiner: Thin horizontal lines over the picture, like an old TV (CRT).

symbols.name: ScreenBlur
symbols.oneLiner: Blurs the whole picture.

symbols.name: Wash
symbols.oneLiner: Covers the whole picture with a pale, steady color while it is on — a white veil, damage red, heat gold. For a flash that lasts an instant, use canvas.flash .

params.name: intensity
params.doc: Veil strength: 0 = nothing, 1 = only the color

symbols.name: DistantLight
symbols.oneLiner: Sunlight: it comes from one direction and lights the whole screen evenly, giving the objects relief.

params.name: direction
params.doc: Where the light comes from, in design space

symbols.name: Haze
symbols.oneLiner: Makes the picture ripple gently, like hot air over asphalt or the view under water. kind picks the starting style ( haze , heat , underwater ); once created, adjust amount / speed .

params.name: amount
params.doc: Strength. Left out = the kind's default

params.name: speed
params.doc: Pace. Left out = the kind's default

params.name: kind
params.doc: haze · heat · underwater. Only picks defaults at construction.

params.name: bias
params.doc: Average offset of the ripple. Left out: the kind's default

symbols.name: Crt
symbols.oneLiner: Imitates an old tube TV (CRT): picture curved at the edges, colors split apart, horizontal lines and dark corners.

params.name: amount
params.doc: How much the picture curves at the edges and darkens at the corners

params.name: chroma
params.doc: How far red, green and blue split apart

symbols.name: Vortex
symbols.oneLiner: Twists the picture into a whirlpool around a point. Without target , the center follows the mouse.

params.name: target
params.doc: Center of the whirlpool: a point or an object; left out = the mouse

symbols.name: ZoomBlur
symbols.oneLiner: A blur in rays from a point, like a fast camera zoom or a jump to light speed. Without center , it follows the mouse.

params.name: center
params.doc: Where the rays come from: a point or an object; left out = the mouse

symbols.name: Kaleidoscope
symbols.oneLiner: Kaleidoscope: repeats a slice of the picture in mirrors around the center, spinning.

params.name: zoom
params.doc: Zooms in (higher) or out (lower) on the picture

symbols.name: Prism
symbols.oneLiner: Splits the picture's colors in rotating directions, like light through a prism.

params.name: amount
params.doc: How far the colors split (small values: 0.002–0.01)

symbols.name: Perspective
symbols.oneLiner: Tilts the picture as if the screen were seen from the side, pulling toward a point. Without target , it follows the mouse.

params.name: target
params.doc: Where the picture tilts toward: a point or an object; None = the mouse

symbols.name: Lamp
symbols.oneLiner: A lamp over the game: it lights up around a point and leaves the rest in shadow, with shine on the objects' edges. Without target , it follows the mouse.

params.name: radius
params.doc: Size of the well-lit area, in design units (follows the zoom)

params.name: range
params.doc: Distance, in design units, beyond which no light reaches

symbols.name: Spotlight
symbols.oneLiner: A spotlight: a cone of light that comes from origin and points at target ; outside the cone it is dark.

params.name: origin
params.doc: Where the light comes from; None = top center

params.name: softness
params.doc: Soft edge of the cone, in degrees

symbols.name: GodRays
symbols.oneLiner: Rays of light from the bright parts of the picture toward a point, like sun through clouds.

params.name: target
params.doc: Where the rays come from. None = mouse

symbols.name: MotionTrail
symbols.oneLiner: A ghost trail of everything that moves on the screen: the objects stay sharp and leave a fading image behind. enabled = False clears the trail.

params.name: fade
params.doc: How much of the trail is left every 1/60 s: 0.85–0.95 gives long trails

symbols.name: ColorSweep
symbols.oneLiner: Tints the picture with 2–4 colors that change along an axis (center to edge, left to right or top to bottom), pulsing slowly.

params.name: colors
params.doc: 2–4 tints of the sweep; None = default palette

symbols.name: ColorWash
symbols.oneLiner: Plasma coloring the picture. After construction, the palette is .colors (not color / color2 / color3).

params.name: colors
params.doc: After construction: a 2–3 color palette. Replaces color / color2 / color3.

symbols.name: CosmicBloom
symbols.oneLiner: Nebula patches coloring the picture, plus glow bursting out of the bright parts.

params.name: bloom
params.doc: Glow strength on the bright pixels

symbols.name: canvas.flash
symbols.oneLiner: A white burst. Not Wash.

symbols.oneLiner: Shakes the camera for an instant.

params.doc: Strength of the shake (10 = default; higher = stronger)

symbols.name: canvas.glitch
symbols.oneLiner: A one-instant picture glitch: the screen jumps and the colors split apart.

symbols.name: canvas.hit_at
symbols.oneLiner: A hit mark: something took the blow and is still alive . A hot white star + a thin ring + short sparks, ~0.2 s. style="disc" is the light version: a disc of light that opens and fades, with no sparks and no direction. count=0 keeps the star and the ring, without sparks. angle aims the sparks in a cone (90 = up); without angle they fly every way. The angle never comes from info — the normal flips side with the order of @collide . Pair it with the body's reaction ( hero.flash() , hero.knock(...) ). No shake / warp; many at the same time (a boss under a barrage). Takes the place the way explosion_at does.
symbols.search: hit_at hit blow strike impact shot damage spark bullet boss disc flash light

params.name: style

symbols.name: canvas.debris_at
symbols.oneLiner: Broken into pieces, no fire : irregular shards fly, spin, shrink and fade over a dust cloud. Matte (does not add light) — it shows on a light background. fall=0 floats (ship, top-down view); fall≈1 falls in an arc (platformer). The color never comes from the Graphic; pass color= . The shards are only paint — they do not collide. Chain it with burst_at (a ship exploding) or hit_at (a rock cracking). Takes the place the way explosion_at does.

symbols.name: SkyGradient
symbols.oneLiner: A sky in a vertical gradient. It becomes the base. The last wallpaper wins. horizon is where the atmosphere ( middle ) sits — 0–1, y-up. palette / top / middle / bottom are fixed at construction — to change the ramp, replace the base. horizon / fade / camera / enabled apply live.
symbols.search: skygradient sky day night sunset dawn dusk space

params.name: palette
params.doc: day · dawn · sunset · dusk · night · space · overcast · desert · forest · toxic · ember · ice · underwater. Any top/middle/bottom skips the preset and fills in the rest from day.

params.name: top
params.doc: Color of the zenith (top of the screen). With middle/bottom, palette is ignored.

params.name: middle
params.doc: Color of the atmosphere, at the horizon.

params.name: bottom
params.doc: Color below the horizon (solid). With horizon=0 it does not show.

params.name: horizon
params.doc: Horizon line (0–1, y-up from the bottom). 0 = sky all the way down (middle at the bottom). Line it up with Ground.

params.name: fade
params.doc: Blends middle → bottom below the line. 0 = a sharp cut. The same parameter as in Ground.

params.name: enabled

symbols.name: Wallpaper
symbols.oneLiner: The base of the background: a color, gradient, image file or texture. Creating it already makes it canvas.background.base . No args: opaque black. A string with . or / is a file; otherwise it is a color. Once created, you can change .source , the camera settings and enabled . fit / tile_mode / scale / tile_size / underlay / filename / image stay fixed — to change them, replace .source or create another Wallpaper. With a camera that moves ( pan_response / zoom_response ), pass tile_mode="mirror" : without it, the underlay (black) shows beyond the image's border.
symbols.search: wallpaper base color image texture fit tile cover contain

params.name: source
params.doc: A color name, tuple, Color, Gradient, Texture, file (str with . or /) or Image. A Visual / SpatialFx / filter raises TypeError.

params.name: filename
params.doc: Instead of source: a path. Searched like Image files.

params.name: image
params.doc: Instead of source: a skia.Image already loaded.

params.name: fit
params.doc: Image only: cover · contain · stretch · tile

params.name: tile_mode
params.doc: Image only: what shows beyond the border when the camera moves or zooms out. decal (nothing; the underlay shows) · clamp (stretches the border) · repeat · mirror (mirrored, no seam). Left out: repeat with fit="tile", otherwise decal. In tile, clamp becomes repeat.

params.name: scale
params.doc: Image only: extra zoom. Must be > 0.

params.name: tile_size
params.doc: Image / fit="tile" only: the cell, in design units. With another fit it is a TypeError.

params.name: underlay
params.doc: Image only: color of the bands left over in fit="contain" and of everything beyond the border with tile_mode="decal". None = does not paint what is left over.

symbols.oneLiner: A game question. Closes on a choice.

symbols.name: Clock
symbols.oneLiner: Type of the clock singleton.

symbols.name: Mouse
symbols.oneLiner: Type of the mouse singleton.

symbols.name: KeyPressed
symbols.oneLiner: Type of the keyp singleton.

symbols.name: Collider
symbols.oneLiner: Several shapes that collide as one body.

symbols.name: CollisionInfo
symbols.oneLiner: What the contact tells you.

symbols.name: SpatialFx
symbols.oneLiner: An effect in space: Fire, Rain, Sparks…

symbols.name: chance
symbols.oneLiner: Yes/no. 0 to 1.

symbols.name: chase
symbols.oneLiner: Chases the target with an exponential lag.

symbols.name: approach
symbols.oneLiner: Moves to the target at constant speed and arrives exactly.

symbols.name: deadzone
symbols.oneLiner: Slack: moves only when the target leaves the box.

symbols.name: lerp
symbols.oneLiner: Blends a → b at t.

symbols.name: remap
symbols.oneLiner: Maps one range onto another.

symbols.name: click
symbols.oneLiner: A click on the object or the Button.

symbols.name: hover
symbols.oneLiner: The cursor entered: it became the hover target.

symbols.name: hover_exit
symbols.oneLiner: It stopped being the hover target.

symbols.name: collide
symbols.oneLiner: Decorator: overlap this frame.

symbols.name: above
symbols.oneLiner: The layer above another.

symbols.name: below
symbols.oneLiner: The layer below another.

symbols.name: amp_db
symbols.oneLiner: Linear → bar height in dB.

symbols.name: STATIC
symbols.oneLiner: Infinite mass: a wall.

symbols.name: ANYTHING
symbols.oneLiner: Matches any collider.

symbols.name: show_tracks
symbols.oneLiner: Debug: overlay of the active move_along tracks.

symbols.name: show_processes
symbols.oneLiner: Debug: panel of the running tasks and modes (Ctrl+Shift+6).

symbols.name: collision.show_colliders
symbols.oneLiner: Debug: overlay of the registered hitboxes (green detection, gold resolve).

symbols.name: when
symbols.oneLiner: @when: runs when it turns from False to True.

symbols.name: on_change
symbols.oneLiner: @on_change: new value != previous.

symbols.name: leave_playfield
symbols.oneLiner: @leave_playfield: the center left.

symbols.name: Act
symbols.oneLiner: One part of the game (title, level, end): class Play(Act). What it creates leaves with it.

symbols.name: change_act
symbols.oneLiner: Leaves the current act and enters another, at once. Always a new one (restart).

symbols.name: on_mode
symbols.oneLiner: Decorator: this method is a mode.

symbols.name: exit_mode
symbols.oneLiner: @exit_mode: cleanup when leaving the chapter.

symbols.name: run_task
symbols.oneLiner: Runs an async sequence alongside everything else (a task).

symbols.name: wait
symbols.oneLiner: Waits N seconds in an async mode.

symbols.name: until
symbols.oneLiner: Waits for the condition / Handle.

symbols.name: parallel
symbols.oneLiner: Waits for all of them.

symbols.name: race
symbols.oneLiner: Waits for the first one.

symbols.name: LowPass
symbols.oneLiner: Low-pass filter on a sound Handle.

symbols.name: HighPass
symbols.oneLiner: High-pass filter on a sound Handle.

symbols.name: Echo
symbols.oneLiner: Echo. The tail goes into the bake.

symbols.name: Reverb
symbols.oneLiner: Reverb. The tail goes into the bake.

symbols.name: Distortion
symbols.oneLiner: Distortion on a sound Handle.

symbols.name: Wavefold
symbols.oneLiner: Wavefold on a sound Handle.

symbols.name: Cancelled
symbols.oneLiner: Cancelled Handle or wait. BaseException — except Exception does not catch it.

symbols.name: FxQuality
symbols.oneLiner: FX fidelity preset. A string works too.

symbols.name: canvas.framerate
symbols.oneLiner: Pacing: vsync60 (default), vsync30, vsync, max or a fixed fps.

symbols.name: set_fx_auto
symbols.oneLiner: Turns FX fidelity auto-tuning on or off.

symbols.name: canvas.display
symbols.oneLiner: Window mode: windowed, maximized or fullscreen.

symbols.name: canvas.fx_quality
symbols.oneLiner: Effects quality: low, medium, high (default) or max.

symbols.name: canvas.cull_offscreen
symbols.oneLiner: True (default): does not draw what is out of view. False draws everything.

symbols.name: canvas.background
symbols.oneLiner: The world's background: a color, a gradient or a background field.

symbols.name: canvas.effects
symbols.oneLiner: Screen effects (Post) applied to the whole picture.

symbols.name: canvas.layers
symbols.oneLiner: The canvas layers, by name.

symbols.name: canvas.layers.create
symbols.oneLiner: Creates a named layer (parallax, hide everything at once).

symbols.name: collide_stay
symbols.oneLiner: Decorator: still overlapping this frame.

symbols.name: collide_exit
symbols.oneLiner: Decorator: just separated.

symbols.name: collide_with
symbols.oneLiner: Method: this object × the other side.

symbols.name: collide_with_stay
symbols.oneLiner: Method: still overlapping.

symbols.name: collide_with_exit
symbols.oneLiner: Method: just separated.

symbols.name: drag_to
symbols.oneLiner: The drag of this shape was released.

symbols.name: drag_over
symbols.oneLiner: A drag passing over it.

symbols.name: drop_by
symbols.oneLiner: Something was dropped on this target.

symbols.name: until_empty
symbols.oneLiner: Waits for the group to empty. Do not use until(group.empty).

symbols.name: set_watchdog
symbols.oneLiner: Turns the freeze watchdog on or off.

symbols.name: intersection
symbols.oneLiner: First crossing of two outlines.

symbols.name: intersections
symbols.oneLiner: Every crossing of two outlines.

symbols.name: set_extrude_focus
symbols.oneLiner: The Extrude light point in the world.

symbols.name: LinkedAttributeError
symbols.oneLiner: Wrote with = to a linked field. Unlink, or force=True on the verb.

symbols.name: DerivedAttributeError
symbols.oneLiner: Tried to write a derived field.

symbols.name: CallableAssignError
symbols.oneLiner: Assigned a function with =. Use ['field'] @= ….

symbols.name: DestroyedError
symbols.oneLiner: The object was already destroyed.

symbols.name: ParallaxLayerError
symbols.oneLiner: Click or collision on a parallax layer.

symbols.name: UiLayerError
symbols.oneLiner: Collision or SpatialFx on the ui layer.

symbols.name: Visual
symbols.oneLiner: The base of the looks (Neon, Glow, …).

symbols.name: Recipe
symbols.oneLiner: The base of the multi-pass looks (Neon, Metal, …).

symbols.name: Paint
symbols.oneLiner: A full color visual (fill + outline).

symbols.name: Fill
symbols.oneLiner: A solid-fill-only visual.

symbols.name: Stroke
symbols.oneLiner: An outline-only visual.

symbols.name: ProceduralFill
symbols.oneLiner: An animated fill (the base of the *Fill factories).

symbols.name: WaveFill
symbols.oneLiner: Animated fill: liquid of any color.

symbols.name: AuroraFill
symbols.oneLiner: Animated fill: aurora bands.

symbols.name: FlameFill
symbols.oneLiner: Animated fill: fire.

symbols.name: WaterFill
symbols.oneLiner: Animated fill: water (side or top view).

symbols.name: SwellFill
symbols.oneLiner: Animated fill: abstract flow.

symbols.name: Colormap
symbols.oneLiner: A continuous sample of a palette.

symbols.name: ColorSpace
symbols.oneLiner: Color space conversion.

symbols.name: ColorNames
symbols.oneLiner: The color names Scena knows.

symbols.name: XPos
symbols.oneLiner: Horizontal side (left, center, right).

symbols.name: AUTO_GROUND
symbols.oneLiner: Automatic ground tilt for a sprite.

symbols.name: TouchingContact
symbols.oneLiner: A contact that is still touching.
